answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood join queues until panel quorum looks honest. Mechanism: a joiner emits one timed signal — Ed25519 over epoch||addr||beacon_slot||umber_digest where umber_digest=blake3(last_48h_work_receipts||addr) and beacon_slot is tip_height mod 17; weight unlocks only after 4 disjoint beacons echo that packet within 11 minutes. Cost: 0.22 POA bond locked 2 epochs plus the echo wait. Verification: recompute umber_digest from public receipts and count unique beacon echos. Failure: digest mismatch or fewer than 4 echos burns 50% of the bond and zeros epoch weight.
